# agent-stocktake

> An Agent Skill that audits agent definitions (`~/.claude/agents/*.md`) with a hybrid cost model: the `description` is always-loaded via the agent-type listing (residency, audited for density, truthfulness, and aggregate word count), while the body loads only on invocation (audited for suppression instructions, previous-generation over-constraint, substrate absorption, currency, and uniqueness). Verdicts: Keep / Improve / Update / Merge / Demote-to-skill / Dissolve / Retire, confirmed one by one.

The premise: an agent definition pays both stocktake cost models at once — a skill's cost is trigger pollution, a rule's cost is residency, and an agent's description is a rule-like resident while its body is a skill-like invocation payload. The two layers get different audit questions.

## Core model

- **Two-layer screen**: eight binary questions — two on the description (earns residency? truthful to body?), six on the body (free of suppression instructions? external-origin copy current? free of over-constraint? not absorbed? references current? unique?).
- **Improve-by-inversion**: suppression instructions (confidence thresholds, severity floors) are rewritten in the opposite direction, never just deleted — deletion leaves the suppressive frame.
- **Fresh/rich context axis** for absorption: fresh-context roles (review, adversarial verification, essence evaluation) legitimately live in subagents; rich-context roles (planning, generation) are main-loop work, so the main loop counts as an absorber. Two overrides: frozen-input render contracts and bulk context isolation.
- **Verdict pressure-test**: non-Keep drafts face refutation questions; a Dissolve claim that cannot name its absorber concretely is refuted.
- **Aggregate residency**: total description words is a set-level judgment input — the Keep bar rises as the listing crowds.
- **Usage as lower bound**: invocation telemetry never triggers a verdict alone; unmeasured renders as `—`, never 0.

## Files

- [SKILL.md](skills/agent-stocktake/SKILL.md): the full skill definition — modes, Phases 1–4, the eight-question screen, verdict table, ledger format.
- [README.md](README.md): overview, install, hybrid cost model, references.
- [README.ja.md](README.ja.md): Japanese README.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history.

## Boundaries

- NOT for skill quality (skill-stocktake), always-loaded rules (rules-stocktake), or cross-asset audits on a model-generation change (generation-audit, which collects evidence and proposes that the user run `/agent-stocktake`).
- Evaluation is origin-blind and holistic — binary answers are evidence, never aggregated into a score.

## About

Extends the Curate phase of the Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19200726) to the agent-definition layer, as the third stocktake skill after skill-stocktake and rules-stocktake. Also shipped in the [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle) plugin as `/akc-cycle:agent-stocktake`. Author: shimo4228. License: MIT. The author's other practice lines are listed on the hub: https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228.

Status: active, synced one way from the author's Claude Code harness (`scripts/sync-from-local.sh`), so this repository can trail the akc-cycle plugin between syncs.
